# Apex Logics — EdTech & CareerTech Intelligence Suite
# https://apexlogics.org

# AP2 Protocol: google_agent_purchase_protocol_sep_2025
# Suite version: registry v3.2.0 · spec v9.7 · contract v1.3
# Last updated: 2026-05-28
# Tools: 35 shipped · 0 deferred · 0 proposed
# Privacy: Zero PII. All computation client-side. No accounts, no tracking.

## Summary

Apex Logics is a suite of 35 deterministic, browser-based career and education decision tools. Every tool is a single self-contained HTML file — no server, no login, no data transmission. Tools export structured AP2 JSON for agent-to-agent handoff across the decision graph. Companion to AINumbers.co (fintech). Built for ApexAdvisory.site consultants and their clients.

## How to Use This File

Each tool block lists: title, AP2 mandate type(s), input summary, output summary, and AP2 handoff connections. Agents should use the AP2 JSON export to carry scenario state across tools. All tools are at https://apexlogics.org{url}.

---

## Category: Education Path & ROI

### #01 · AL-02 — Credential ROI Suite
URL: /tools/credential-roi-suite/
AP2 mandate: credential_roi_evaluation
Inputs: credential type (bootcamp / degree / certification), cost, duration, current salary, target SOC code
Outputs: NPV, payback period, salary lift, opportunity cost
Handoffs out: credential_roi_evaluation → AL-26
Data: BLS OEWS May 2023 (16 SOC codes) · CIRR/SwitchUp 2023 · NCES IPEDS 2022-23 · Q4 2024 exam fees

### #02 · AL-17 — FAFSA SAI Simulator
URL: /tools/fafsa-sai-simulator/
AP2 mandate: fafsa_sai_estimate
Inputs: income, assets, household size, dependency status, enrollment
Outputs: Student Aid Index (SAI), estimated Pell Grant, Expected Family Contribution
Handoffs out: fafsa_sai_estimate → AL-02, AL-26
Data: 2026-27 award year (Federal Register 2025-10243)

### #03 · AL-26 — Graduate School ROI Comparator
URL: /tools/graduate-school-roi-comparator/
AP2 mandate: graduate_school_roi_record
AP2 inbound: credential_roi_evaluation (AL-02), fafsa_sai_estimate (AL-17)
Inputs: up to 4 programs, COA, opportunity cost, post-grad salary by specialization
Outputs: payback period, NPV at 7%, break-even year
Data: NCES IPEDS 2023-24 · BLS OEWS May 2023 · MBA Employment Reports 2023

### #17 · AL-29 — MBA Program Fit & ROI Ranker
URL: /tools/mba-program-fit-ranker/
AP2 mandate: mba_roi_evaluation
AP2 inbound: credential_roi_evaluation (AL-02), graduate_school_roi_record (AL-26)
Inputs: GMAT/GRE score, work experience, specialization, up to 4 target programs
Outputs: fit score, COA, post-MBA salary, payback, NPV
Handoffs out: mba_roi_evaluation → AL-30
Data: NCES IPEDS 2023-24 · FT Global MBA Rankings 2024 · Bloomberg Businessweek 2024

### #18 · AL-30 — Test Prep Investment Analyzer
URL: /tools/test-prep-investment-analyzer/
AP2 mandate: test_prep_roi_record
AP2 inbound: mba_roi_evaluation (AL-29)
Inputs: exam type (GMAT/GRE/TOEFL/IELTS/LSAT/MCAT), current score, target score, prep cost
Outputs: ROI of prep investment, admissions tier shift, scholarship lift
Data: GMAT/GRE/TOEFL/IELTS/LSAT/MCAT 2024 percentiles · Kaplan/Princeton Review 2024

### #19 · AL-31 — International Student Cost Modeler
URL: /tools/international-student-cost-modeler/
AP2 mandate: international_student_cost_record
Inputs: home country, US program type, duration, living city, visa status
Outputs: F-1 visa total cost, OPT/STEM OPT earnings window, H-1B sponsorship rate by employer
Handoffs out: international_student_cost_record → AL-09
Legal disclaimer: educational use only. Not legal advice.
Data: US Dept of State 2024 · USCIS H-1B FY2020-FY2024 · BLS regional CPI · QS 2024

### #20 · AL-32 — Parent College ROI Planner
URL: /tools/parent-college-roi-planner/
AP2 mandate: parent_college_roi_record
AP2 inbound: fafsa_sai_estimate (AL-17)
Inputs: child age, savings rate, school tier, asset type, loan appetite
Outputs: 529 projection, SAI asset impact, COA by school tier, loan vs. gift split
Data: NCES IPEDS 2023-24 · Federal Pell Grant 2024-25 · Parent PLUS 7.54% 2024-25

Tab 2: reverse-solve contribution optimizer, 7x8 sensitivity table
Data: IRS Pub. 970 (2025) · State 529 rules Jan 2026 · NCES IPEDS 2023-24 · SECURE 2.0 Act

## Category: Compensation & Offers

### #04 · AL-23 — Benefits Open Enrollment Optimizer
URL: /tools/benefits-open-enrollment-optimizer/
AP2 mandate: benefits_election_record
Inputs: health plan options, usage estimates, HSA/FSA elections, 401k match
Outputs: optimal plan selection, HSA/FSA tax savings (incl. FICA exemption), 401k match capture
Data: 2025 IRS limits: HSA $4,300/$8,550 · FSA $3,300 · 401(k) $23,500

### #05 · AL-25 — Offer Negotiation Suite
URL: /tools/offer-negotiation-suite/
AP2 mandate: offer_negotiation_record
Inputs: base salary, bonus, equity, benefits, counteroffer targets
Outputs: negotiation script, total comp estimate, walk-away range
Handoffs out: offer_negotiation_record → AL-27, AL-01, AL-22, AL-33, AL-04

### #21 · AL-33 — Equity Compensation Analyzer
URL: /tools/equity-compensation-analyzer/
AP2 mandate: equity_compensation_record
AP2 inbound: offer_negotiation_record (AL-25)
Inputs: RSU grant, ISO/NSO options, strike price, vesting schedule, projected stock price
Outputs: vesting schedule (5 patterns), intrinsic value, AMT flag (IRC §55), after-tax proceeds, NPV at 7%
Tab 2: 3-offer total comp stack over 4 years
Legal: IRC §422, §83, §55. Not tax advice.
Data: IRS AMT exemption 2024 · IRS LTCG brackets 2024

### #23 · AL-22 — Freelance / 1099 Total Cost Calculator
URL: /tools/freelance-1099-total-cost-calculator/
AP2 mandate: freelance_total_cost_record
AP2 inbound: offer_negotiation_record (AL-25)
Inputs: W-2 salary, 1099 rate, state, filing status, deduction items
Outputs: W-2 vs. 1099 tax equivalence (binary search), gross equivalence rate
Tab 2: Deduction Discovery Engine (8 items: home office, mileage, health insurance, SEP-IRA, etc.)
Data: 2026 est. federal brackets · IRS SE tax · IRS mileage $0.70/mi · SEP-IRA limit $70K

### #25 · AL-01 — Total Compensation Suite
URL: /tools/total-compensation-suite/
AP2 mandate: total_comp_record
AP2 inbound: offer_negotiation_record (AL-25), equity_compensation_record (AL-33), geo_arbitrage_record (AL-04)
Inputs: up to 3 offers — base, bonus (guaranteed/target), equity (RSU/options), vest schedule, 401k match, health tier, HSA, filing status, state
Outputs: after-tax total comp per offer, stacked bar comparison, winner highlight
Tab 2: RSU year-by-year tax events + Black-Scholes options (Abramowitz-Stegun), 5-scenario table
Handoffs out: total_comp_record → AL-33, AL-04
Data: 2026 est. federal brackets · 8-tier state effective rates · FICA SS $176,100

### #26 · AL-04 — Geo-Fiscal Arbitrage Simulator
URL: /tools/geo-fiscal-arbitrage-simulator/
AP2 mandate: geo_arbitrage_record
AP2 inbound: offer_negotiation_record (AL-25)
Inputs: source city, target city, salary, filing status
Outputs: CoL-equivalent salary, purchasing power change, annual after-tax delta, category breakdown
Tab 2: remote pay policy — employer city, employee city, pay policy (full/partial/uniform), 3-city comparison, break-even cut %
Handoffs out: geo_arbitrage_record → AL-01, AL-25
Data: 70 US metros · C2ER/Numbeo CoL index est. 2025-26 · housing 30%, food 14%, healthcare 10%, transport 12%, misc 34%

AP2 mandates: automation_exposure_score, career_resilience_score

Data: Frey & Osborne (2013) · LinkedIn Skills on the Rise 2025 · WEF Future of Jobs 2025

### #07 · AL-08+14 — Career Transition Suite
URL: /tools/career-transition-suite/
AP2 mandates: career_pivot_assessment, career_transition_record
AP2 inbound: automation_exposure_score (AL-06+16)
Inputs: current role, target role, runway (months), salary delta, skill proximity, market demand
Outputs: composite Pivot Risk Score (0-100, four tiers), Skill Match Analyzer (12 skills, weighted %)
Handoffs out: career_pivot_assessment/career_transition_record → AL-28

### #08 · AL-24 — Separation Package Analyzer
URL: /tools/severance-decision-engine/
AP2 mandate: severance_decision_record
Inputs: severance amount, weeks, payment structure, benefits continuation, non-compete, COBRA
Outputs: tax-net severance (IRS 22%/37% supplemental rate), accept vs. negotiate recommendation
Handoffs out: severance_decision_record → AL-08+14, AL-28
Legal: IRC §3402, §3121(a). Not legal advice.

### #09 · AL-27 — Job Search ROI Tracker
URL: /tools/job-search-roi-tracker/
AP2 mandate: job_search_roi_record
AP2 inbound: offer_negotiation_record (AL-25)
Inputs: applications by channel, interviews, offers, time invested
Outputs: ROI by channel (cost per offer), accept vs. continue analysis
Handoffs out: job_search_roi_record → AL-28, AL-25

### #10 · AL-28 — Career Break & Reentry Cost Engine
URL: /tools/career-break-reentry-engine/
AP2 mandate: career_break_record
AP2 inbound: severance_decision_record (AL-24), career_pivot_assessment (AL-08+14)
Inputs: break duration, pre-break salary, industry, planned activities, reentry timeline
Outputs: total cost of break (income loss + benefits + retirement gap + skill decay premium), reentry salary range
Handoffs out: career_break_record → AL-03, AL-08+14

## Category: Immigration & Visa

### #27 · AL-09 — Visa Strategy Navigator
URL: /tools/visa-strategy-navigator/
AP2 mandate: visa_strategy_record
AP2 inbound: international_student_cost_record (AL-31)
Inputs: profession, degree level, years experience, employer type, current visa status, nationality, achievements (publications/patents/awards), foreign employment history
Outputs: scored pathways for 7 US work visas (H-1B, O-1A, O-1B, L-1A/L-1B, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, E-3/H-1B1) — strength level, approval rate, processing time, cost estimate, qualifying criteria checklist
Tab 2: Green Card timeline modeler — priority date estimate, backlog wait by country (India EB-2 NIW ~35yr, EB-3 ~40yr; China EB-2 ~12yr), milestone path
Handoffs out: visa_strategy_record → AL-31
Legal disclaimer: Educational information only. Not legal advice. Consult a licensed immigration attorney.
Data: USCIS FY2025-26 approval rates · DOS Visa Bulletin GC backlog estimates

## Category: Compensation & Offers — New (2026-05-28)

### #29 · AL-34 — AI Skills Premium Calculator
URL: /tools/ai-skills-premium-calculator/
AP2 mandate: ai_skills_premium_record
Inputs: role category (14 BLS categories), current AI skills owned, target AI skills to acquire
Outputs: salary premium percentage (capped at 56%), annual premium $, upskilling cost and months, NPV at 1/3/5 years at 5% discount rate
Handoffs out: ai_skills_premium_record → AL-02, AL-03, AL-06+16
Data: BLS OEWS 2024 median salaries · PwC AI Jobs Barometer 2025 premium coefficients · upskilling cost/time estimates

### #30 · AL-35 — Federal vs. Private Sector Comp Comparator
URL: /tools/federal-vs-private-comp-comparator/
AP2 mandate: federal_comp_record
Inputs: GS grade (5–15), step (1–10), locality (15 areas), coverage (self/family), private-sector base + bonus + 401k match
Outputs: annual and 20-year lifetime value comparison; FERS pension NPV (20yr horizon at 3%); FEHB value; TSP match; leave value; winner determination
Handoffs out: federal_comp_record → AL-01, AL-04
Key insight: pension NPV often reverses apparent base-pay gap in favor of federal
Data: OPM 2026 GS Pay Tables · FEHB 2025 enrollee premiums · FERS handbook

### #32 · AL-37 — Remote Work Tax Mapper
URL: /tools/remote-work-tax-mapper/
AP2 mandate: remote_tax_record
Inputs: residence state, employer state, gross salary, filing status (single/MFJ), WFH days %
Outputs: state + federal + FICA tax across three scenarios (current / move to employer state / 100% WFH); reciprocity flag; NY/PA convenience-of-employer doctrine warning
Handoffs out: remote_tax_record → AL-04
Data: 2025 state income tax rates (all 50 + DC) · IRS 2025 federal brackets · FICA SS wage base $176,100

### #33 · AL-38 — Non-Compete Risk & Enforceability Screener
URL: /tools/noncompete-risk-screener/
AP2 mandate: noncompete_risk_record
Inputs: state signed, state of work, duration, geographic scope, salary, role type, consideration type, garden leave clause
Outputs: 0–100 enforceability risk score; label (Low/Moderate/Elevated/High); state law tier (void/restrictive/moderate/broad); flags; recommendation; disclaimer
Handoffs out: noncompete_risk_record → AL-25
Legal disclaimer: General legal information only. Not legal advice.
Data: State non-compete statute classifications as of 2025 (CA/MN/ND/OK/DC = void; CO/IL/MA/OR/WA = restrictive; FL/GA = broad)

### #31 · AL-36 — Trade vs. Degree ROI Engine
URL: /tools/trade-vs-degree-roi-engine/
AP2 mandate: education_path_record
Inputs: trade/certification or degree path selection, state, current age, public vs. private school
Outputs: net investment, 20-year NPV at 3%, break-even years, peak annual wage, BLS job growth %; canvas earnings trajectory chart
Handoffs out: education_path_record → AL-02, AL-13, AL-39
Data: BLS OEWS 2024 · BLS Employment Projections 2022-32 · NCES IPEDS 2023 tuition · apprenticeship income $20K/yr credit

### #34 · AL-39 — Professional Degree ROI Ranker
URL: /tools/professional-degree-roi-ranker/
AP2 mandate: professional_degree_record
Inputs: 1–3 degree paths (MD/DO/JD/PharmD/DVM/MBA/BA), specialty, school cost, scholarship, current age
Outputs: break-even age, career NPV, DTI ratio, 13-row side-by-side comparison table, winner (teal border + crown); DTI >2.0 and break-even >50 warnings
Handoffs out: professional_degree_record → AL-26, AL-13
Data: AAMC 2024 physician specialty salary survey · NALP 2024 associate salary survey · BLS OEWS 2024 · NCES IPEDS 2023-24

## Category: Career Transition & Mobility — New (2026-05-28)

### #35 · AL-40 — Military-to-Civilian Salary Bridge
URL: /tools/military-civilian-salary-bridge/
AP2 mandate: military_civilian_record
Inputs: pay grade (E-1 through O-10), years of service, dependents, duty station metro (20 areas), separation type, target civilian sector, GI Bill flag
Outputs: military total comp breakdown (base + BAH + BAS + TRICARE + TSP + leave); civilian salary floor (22% gross-up of tax-free allowances); sector-adjusted floor; benefits gap cards; optional GI Bill annual value; pension estimate (retirement)
Handoffs out: military_civilian_record → AL-01
Data: DoD 2025 base pay tables · BAH rates 2025 · BAS flat rates 2025 · GI Bill housing/tuition caps 2024-25

## Technical Constraints (All Tools)

- Single self-contained .html file per tool. No external dependencies post-load.
- Zero network calls. No fetch, XHR, WebWorker, or CDN after page load.
- Zero PII. No storage, logging, or transmission of personal data.
- sessionStorage: apex_lang key only (UI language preference).
- Fonts: Google Fonts (DM Serif Display, Sora, JetBrains Mono) loaded at page open only.
- i18n: EN/ES/FR/AR/PT/Chinese language toggle on every tool.
- AP2 export: JSON + Markdown download. AP2Schema.validate() runs before any download.
- PII banner: "All inputs are processed locally in your browser. Nothing is transmitted, stored, or logged."
- License: CC BY 4.0. Source readable and attribution-ready.
